subject: general
question: What is the duration of Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5 years**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **5 years** is the duration of the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY).
 
• The PMMSY aims to bring about a Blue Revolution through sustainable and responsible development of the fisheries sector in India.
 
• It focuses on enhancing fish production and productivity, modernizing the fisheries sector, and increasing the income of fishers and fish farmers.
 
• Launched in 2020, the scheme is set to be implemented over a period of five years, from FY 2020-21 to FY 2024-25.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana** is a flagship scheme of the Government of India for focused and sustainable development of the fisheries sector.
 
• It aims to address critical gaps in the value chain, including infrastructure modernization, post-harvest management, and market linkages.
 
• The scheme is expected to generate substantial employment opportunities and double the incomes of fishers and fish farmers.
 
• It also emphasizes the adoption of modern technologies and practices to ensure the sustainability and environmental conservation of marine and inland fisheries resources.
 
• PMMSY is part of the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan (Self-Reliant India Campaign), aiming to make India self-sufficient in fish production and export.
